checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One ~10s landscape video with music embedded
must.why: Video is landscape and 10 s. The audio file is 15 s and listed separately, so embedding is not confirmed.

must.item: Neon signs, moving train, wet street reflections at night
must.why: Dusk city with some glowing signs. No train and no wet reflections. The streets look dry.

must.item: Upbeat electronic instrumental audible across montage, no vocals
must.why: The audio has sound, but its content can't be judged. It is 15 s, not 10 s.

must.item: At least two shot changes coincide with audible beats
must.why: Only one shot change is visible (aerial to street), so two cannot be met.
No overlaid text in any frame.

faults.what: No train anywhere in the video
Streets look dry, with no wet reflections, and the scene is dusk rather than full night
Only two shots, so there are not two or more beat-synced cuts
Audio file is 15 s, which does not match the 10 s video

summary: The result is a clean, good-looking dusk city video in two shots. It lacks the required train, wet reflections and enough cuts, and the 15 s audio does not match the 10 s video.
